name: openpixo/vaporwave-crt
title: Vaporwave / CRT
description: Dusk colors, geometric horizons and restrained screen texture for retro game worlds.

description_i18n.en: Dusk colors, geometric horizons and restrained screen texture for retro game worlds.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 以暮色色调、几何地平线和克制屏幕纹理，打造复古游戏世界。

examples.title: Arcade shoreline
examples.prompt: Generate a retro-futurist shoreline background using the vaporwave-crt art style, with a geometric sun, distant angular cliffs and calm reflective water. Keep scanlines faint and leave a clear gameplay foreground.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 vaporwave-crt 美术风格生成复古未来海岸背景：几何太阳、远处棱角悬崖和平静反光水面。扫描线保持轻微，并为玩法前景留出清晰空间。

examples.title: Neon pickup set
examples.prompt: Create four matching arcade pickup icons using the vaporwave-crt art style: energy prism, cassette-shaped data chip, crystal key and shield cell. Use clean silhouettes with restrained cyan and coral glow.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 vaporwave-crt 美术风格制作四枚配套街机拾取物图标：能量棱晶、磁带形数据芯片、水晶钥匙和护盾电池。轮廓干净，青色与珊瑚色辉光保持克制。

style.prompt: Retro-futurist game artwork in a dusk violet, muted cyan and coral palette. Bold geometric silhouettes, simple stepped gradients and a low distant horizon, with controlled emissive accents. Apply only a faint consistent horizontal CRT scanline texture and a tiny color-fringe at bright edges; keep the underlying asset clean and its silhouette sharp.
style.negativePrompt: photorealism, dense glitch noise, heavy scanlines, unreadable bloom, excessive chromatic aberration, muddy black levels, brand logos, real product names, text, watermark

constraints.outline: Sharp graphic contours with restrained emissive edge accents.
